## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle ritual manual by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) for the Esoteric *dhāraṇī*-recitation practice associated with his retranslation of the *Rénwáng jīng* 仁王經 ([KR6f0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0019) T246, the *Sūtra for Humane Kings* in his 765 recension). The text gives the *yoga-tantra*-grade ritual frame for the *Rénwáng* dhāraṇīs, providing the ceremonial liturgical context for the state-protection rites. It is the central liturgical companion to Amoghavajra's *Rénwáng* translation programme and was the principal reference for the Tang court rites of imperial protection.

**Abstract**

The *Rénwáng jīng* state-protection cult was systematically reformulated by Amoghavajra under emperors Sùzōng (r. 756–762), Dàizōng (r. 762–779), in close alignment with the Tang court's response to the [安祿山](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%89%E7%A5%BF%E5%B1%B1) Ān Lùshān rebellion. Amoghavajra translated his expanded *yoga-tantra*-grade *Rénwáng jīng* (T246) in 765, and produced this companion ritual manual T994 to support the state-protection rites that he and his disciples performed at the Cháng'ān and Luòyáng court complexes through the 765–774 period. The companion texts include [KR6j0184](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0184) (*Rénwáng bōrě niànsòngfǎ* T995) and [KR6j0185](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0185) (*Rénwáng bōrě tuóluóní shì* T996), forming a tight cluster of three Esoteric extensions to the *Rénwáng* corpus. The principal study is Charles Orzech's *Politics and Transcendent Wisdom* (1998), which provides the comprehensive analysis of the *Rénwáng*-state-protection ritual programme and Amoghavajra's central role in it.
